meta.title: VoxNexus — Hand work over, by voice | Agentware Studio
meta.description: VoxNexus is a voice AI agent platform: create an agent by speaking, and let it handle real work over voice. Connected to your business systems, it looks up records, logs requests, and hands calls over.

name: VoxNexus
summary: A voice AI agent platform: describe an agent aloud, and it handles real work through natural conversation.
features: Natural voice conversations with instant barge-in across languages
Lookups, intake, bookings, and updates across connected business systems
Connects to existing systems via MCP and APIs, with support for external tools
Seamless hand-over between agents and staff with full conversation context
Admin Agent creates and configures Voice Agents
Admin Agent diagnoses call failures and answers how-to questions
Per-action rules (allow, confirm with the caller, or refuse), human approval for key changes, and full audit logs

hero.title:
Hand work over,
by voice.
hero.lead: Create AI agents just by speaking. They take the call and see the job through.

shift.now: Now: it hears what you need and sees it through.

items.title: Stock and delivery dates
items.body: When a customer calls, it checks the production system and answers on the spot, nights and weekends included.

items.title: Repair intake and hand-over
items.body: “The machine has stopped.” It logs the symptom and machine ID, opens a ticket, and passes the full conversation to the person in charge.

items.title: Bulk notices
items.body: Delivery updates and inspection reminders go out automatically within the hours and redial rules you set.

items.title: Questions in Teams meetings
items.body: It joins the meeting and answers questions about stock and progress as they come up.

items.title: Orders and bookings
items.body: From identity checks to lookups and change requests. Before it changes anything, it confirms with the customer.

items.title: Account details
items.body: It pulls up what is on record and answers—and clearly refuses any operation it is not allowed to perform.

items.title: Hand-over to staff
items.body: Everything gathered is passed along intact, so customers never have to explain twice.

items.title: Internal help desk
items.body: Answers questions on policies and procedures directly from your internal documents.

items.title: Across languages
items.body: It speaks English or Chinese with staff from abroad, switching to the caller’s language.

items.title: Requests
items.body: Takes leave and equipment requests by voice and logs them directly into your business systems.

trust.title: It refuses what isn’t allowed.
items: Requires human approval for important changes
Logs every operation and lets you restore earlier settings
Runs on your own servers so call records stay inside the company

items.q: How is this different from an ordinary phone menu?
items.a: A phone menu follows fixed menus and scripts. A VoxNexus Voice Agent understands what callers need, runs lookups, intake and updates in your connected systems, and hands over when needed.

items.q: Can it connect to the production system we already have?
items.a: Yes, through MCP and APIs. For each connected operation you decide whether it is allowed, confirmed with the customer first, or refused.
English, Japanese, Chinese and more, switching automatically to the caller’s language.

items.q: Can we use it without specialist knowledge?
items.a: Tell the Admin Agent what you need and it drafts the Voice Agent’s configuration. It also answers how-to questions and guides you through setup.

items.q: What if the caller wants a person?
items.a: It hands the call over to a human operator along with the full conversation.
Yes. It joins the meeting and answers questions on the spot from your connected systems.
On your own servers, with call records kept inside the company.
